name: power_mux_usb_bat
title: HeyPCB Power Mux - USB-C first, 1S cell as backup, TPS2116
brief: USB / battery power mux: USB-C 5 V on VIN1 has priority, a 1S cell on a JST PH takes over below about 4.3 V, TPS2116 ideal-diode switching (2.5 A, 40 mOhm, no reverse current); a LED and an ST pin say when the cell is in use; OUT / GND / ST / BAT on a 2.54 mm header; 28 x 32 mm, 2 layers.

netClasses.name: PWR
netClasses.why: the 2.5 A paths are carried in board.zones; 0.8 mm is the target for the short entries, which the ladder may neck to the SOT-583's 0.5 mm-pitch leads

rules.why_min_track: Freerouting necks into the SOT-583's 0.5 mm-pitch pins; JLCPCB 2-layer builds 0.127 mm

board.notes: 2 layers: F.Cu signal + GND pour, B.Cu signal + GND pour, both poured after routing.

zones.name: vusb
zones.why: the receptacle's VBUS pins, the input caps and the PR1 divider to the mux's VIN1 pin: up to 2.5 A

zones.name: vbat
zones.why: the cell connector's + pin and its cap to the header's BAT pin, passing under the mux's VIN2 side: up to 2.5 A

zones.name: vout
zones.why: the mux's VOUT pins and the output cap to the header's OUT pin: up to 2.5 A

usb:J?.why: USB-C plugs in from the left edge, upper half

bat:J?.why: the cell's lead plugs in from the left edge, lower half

out:J?.why: output header along the right edge, pin 1 (OUT) at the top; the strip left of it is kept free for its labels

mux:U?.why: mux between the two inputs on the left and the header on the right

mux:C1?.why: VIN1 cap between the USB-C and the mux

mux:C2?.why: VIN2 cap between the cell connector and the mux

mux:C3?.why: output cap beside the VOUT pins, left of the header's label strip

mux:R1?.why: PR1 divider top, fed from VIN1

mux:R3?.why: ST pull-up up top beside the PR1 divider, so no ST or VOUT track crosses the VBAT zone below the mux

mux:R4?.why: BATT LED resistor beside the LED, above the VOUT zone

switches.why: + beside the pad on VBAT, - beside GND: JST PH cells do not agree on polarity

captions.place_3d: USB-C and the cell connector on the left edge, the TPS2116 between them and the output header on the right edge.
captions.done_3d: TPS2116 priority power mux: USB-C first, a 1S cell below 4.3 V, ST pin and BATT LED, OUT / GND / ST / BAT header.
